facts.activity_file: isolating and depressuring a leaking system
facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: corrective action following ICAM investigation at TK-7104

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on TK-7104 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. TK-7104 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 5 September 2018 a corrective action on TK-7104 at Cape Verity Export Terminal was reviewed against the critical control it was raised to restore.
